name: airvault
description: Secure end-to-end encrypted file transfer for desktop and mobile devices

scripts.build: npm run build -w @airvault/protocol && npm run build -w @airvault/relay && npm run build -w @airvault/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @airvault/protocol && npm run test -w @airvault/relay
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @airvault/protocol && npm run build -w @airvault/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @airvault/relay && npm run typecheck -w @airvault/desktop
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
